findings.evidence: Definitions occur at `Algebra/Group/Prod.lean:65,71`, `Algebra/Module/Torsion/Basic.lean:50,79`, and `Data/ZMod/Torsion.lean:25`; repository searches find no corresponding `_apply`, `_symm_apply`, or `_def` lemmas.
